March 2, 2018 - By Peter Kolinski 
Baldwin Brothers Inc increased its stake in Hlthcare Tr Of Amer (HTA) by 55.95% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baldwin Brothers Inc bought 55,241 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 153,966 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $4.59 million, up from 98,725 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baldwin Brothers Inc who had been investing in Hlthcare Tr Of Amer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.28B market cap company. The stock increased 0.84% or $0.21 during the last trading session, reaching $25.25. About 900,884 shares traded. Healthcare Trust of America, Inc. (NYSE:HTA) has risen 7.80% since March 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.90% the S&P500. 
Nathan Fischel increased its stake in Alder Biopharmaceuticals Inc (ALDR) by 56.56% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. (NASDAQ:ALDR) has declined 33.67% since March 2, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 50.37% the S&P500. 
Baldwin Brothers Inc, which manages about $939.93M and $621.98M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8,895 shares to 179,210 shares, valued at $27.62M in 2017Q3, according to the filing.
